pages.text: Magma Rift, Ember Grove, Sulfur Springs, Ember Meadow, Crimson Forest, Nether Wastes. A temple surrounded by a $(l)lava moat$(): cross the bridge, survive the Blaze altars and the Ember Stalkers of the courtyard.

The antechamber has lava channels and two ritual rooms (Magma Cube and Stalker spawners, chests). Then the arena of the $(l)Infernal Warlock$(), and the sealed treasury (Warlock Staff, Magma Treads, netherite...).
